Azure OpenAI returns a 401 Unauthorized error when the API key is missing or invalid — uses Azure's error envelope shape with code AccessDenied

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { Message, createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  try {
    await client.chat({ messages: [{ role: "user", user: { content: "Hello" } } as Message], model: "azure/gpt-4" });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof Error) {
      console.error(`${error.name}: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }
}

void main();
```
